course.title: Introduction to Computer Science and Engineering
course.summary: This course covers Introduction to Computer Science and Engineering. The curriculum comprises: Unit 1: Introduction; Unit 2: Problem Solving using Computers; Unit 3: Building Blocks of Computer Programs; Unit 4: Elements of Computer Programming; Unit 5: Basic Algorithms; Unit 6: Basic Data Structures. The syllabus includes laboratory and practical exercises.

course_outcomes.statement: Explain the fundamental concepts of computing, algorithms, programming, and data structures.
Apply pseudocode, flowchart and programming constructs to solve computable problems.
Analyze computational problems by selecting appropriate algorithms, programming constructs, and data structures for efficient solutions.
Evaluate various programming constructs and data structures.
Develop programmatic solutions for computable problems.

units.title: Introduction
units.lab: Edit and execute Python programs using Python command line, Using IDE (Interactive mode, Script mode)

units.title: Elements of Computer Programming
units.lab: on Problem Solving Using random number generation.

units.title: Basic Algorithms
units.lab: on Problem Solving Using Iterative and recursive algorithms.

units.title: Basic Data Structures
units.lab: Implement array operations (insertion, deletion, traversal and searching), stack operations (push, pop and peek) using arrays, queue operations (enqueue and dequeue) using arrays, and develop programs demonstrating stack and queue applications.
